origin: Inter Europol Competition began as a passion project fueled by Polish motorsport enthusiasts in the early 2010s. Initially, a group of friends, spearheaded by Jakub Śmiechowski, pooled their resources and mechanical expertise to enter local endurance races. Their early forays were characterized by shoestring budgets, late nights wrenching in borrowed garages, and a 'never give up' attitude that quickly endeared them to fellow competitors and fans. A pivotal moment came when they secured a sponsorship from Inter Europol, a bakery company, which provided the financial boost needed to expand their operations and compete on a more serious regional level.
philosophy: The team's racing philosophy is rooted in maximizing available resources through smart strategy and relentless dedication. They believe in developing drivers and engineers internally, fostering a collaborative environment where innovation is encouraged. Car development focuses on reliability and efficiency, aiming to outlast and outsmart more well-funded rivals. Their team culture is one of camaraderie and hard work, emphasizing teamwork and a shared passion for motorsport.
achievements: Several class wins in regional endurance championships
Participation in the European Le Mans Series (ELMS)
Finishing on the podium in an ELMS race
Developing several Polish drivers who have progressed to higher levels of motorsport

teamPrincipal.name: Jakub Śmiechowski
teamPrincipal.background: Jakub is the driving force behind Inter Europol Competition. He's a hands-on leader with a deep understanding of motorsport and a knack for inspiring his team to overcome challenges.

keyFigures.name: Sascha Fassbender
keyFigures.description: Sascha brings a wealth of experience in motorsport engineering, overseeing the team's car development and strategy. He is known for his meticulous approach and ability to extract maximum performance from limited resources.

headquarters: The team operates from a modest workshop near Warsaw, Poland. Facilities are basic but functional, reflecting the team's resourcefulness and focus on on-track performance rather than lavish amenities.
fanBase: Inter Europol Competition enjoys a dedicated following in Poland, with fans appreciating their underdog status and commitment to promoting Polish motorsport talent. Their distinctive livery and passionate approach make them a popular team at races across Europe.
